task_detail:
Pin Styling Rules:
Apply specific border styles for FM vendor pins to visually differentiate them on the map.

Contractor–Driver Selection Dependency:
When a contractor is selected, the corresponding driver list should automatically update based on that contractor.

Required Label Fix:
The “Required” label should only appear when the Publish Status option is selected.

Optimize Manifest Option (Google Maps):
Test and optimize the “Manifest Optimization” feature to calculate the shortest route distance using Google Maps.

Vendor Label Update:
Change the label format to:
Vendor Name (bold text) followed by (Vendor Location) for clarity.

Distance Unit Conversion:
Convert distance measurements from meters to miles throughout the Pickup Map.

Manifest Summary Updates:
Display total miles and total driving hours.
Use black text for status.
Correct the item counts to show as: Attached Count / Available Count.

Order Filter Enhancement:
The order filter should support comma-separated, space-separated, and multi-line order entries.

Vendor Location Table Update:
Add a new column for Default Service Time in the Vendor Location table.

Vendor Rules Configuration:
Introduce an option to manage Vendor Rules through a new table.

Manifest Summary – Available Orders:
Add a clickable count for Available Orders that opens a list of all attachable orders for the selected stop.

Manifest Change Log:
Reintroduce the Change Log option for manifest updates and tracking.
